name: Lake Erie College
academic_ranking: Private liberal arts college founded in 1856 (originally Lake Erie Female Seminary; coeducational since 1985). Located on a suburban 52-acre campus in Painesville, OH. After a 2025 restructuring it comprises three academic schools: Education; Business and Professional Studies; and STREAMS (science, technology, research, engineering, animal and medical sciences). Popular majors include criminal justice, psychology, and English; the college is well known for its equine studies program (since 1955). The Business school is IACBE-accredited.
financial_aid: FAFSA school code 003066. Aid includes merit scholarships based on GPA ranging from Leadership ($15,000) to Presidential ($23,000); specialty scholarships (Twin, Legacy, Equine Talent, and Athletic); regional awards (Cuyahoga Connect, Tri-County - $15,000/year for four years for commuters); Choose Ohio First (STEMM); and EmpowerVetEd. Grants include Federal Pell, OCOG, FSEOG, and TEACH. Federal Direct/PLUS loans and Federal Work Study also available. Specific percentage of students receiving aid not publicly stated (checked 2026-07).
facilities_notes: Athletics facilities associated with the program include Classic Park and Diamond 9 at Rec Park (Painesville Kiwanis Recreation Park), per lakeeriestorm.com (checked 2026-07). No dedicated softball-scholarship count is publicly listed.
program_reputation: NCAA Division II member competing in the Great Midwest Athletic Conference (G-MAC). Teams are nicknamed the Storm. Softball carries a 16-player roster for 2026.
notes: Sources conflict on the head coach: the athletics staff directory (lakeeriestorm.com/staff-directory) lists Courtney Orr as Softball Head Coach, while the softball coaches page (lakeeriestorm.com/sports/softball/coaches) does not show a head coach and lists only Adrianna Sluga (Assistant Coach) plus Athletic Trainer Abby Hicks. Both individuals are included below. Tuition is 2026-2027 full-time undergraduate rate of $37,800/year ($18,900/semester) plus general fees; verified at lec.edu/tuition-and-fees.
